title: (Scripture Reading Exercise.)
author: B. H. Roberts
note: Second Year of the Seventy's Course in Theology. Covers the dispensations of the Gospel.

footnotes.text: In lieu of the usual detached notes, in lesson viii and ix, I present an unbroken discussion of the Fall of Adam and the Purpose of Man's Earth Life, which I think will be more satisfactory than any collection of detached notes that I could present to the students upon this very important subject. The students will be under the necessity of selecting from the discussion such ideas and data as wrill apply to the part of the subject assigned to him. Suggestion to the class teacher: Make your assignment today for Lesson XIII, a discussion and see note on Lesson six.
